text:
sam: seeing a spike of 503s in eu-prod around 10:22, looks correlated with the canary hosts. can we pause the v3.2.1 rollout? pinging @leo oncall

deploy-bot: detected incident 'EU-INGRESS-503'. Scheduled canary rollout v3.2.1 -> prod-eu in 3m. Per incident policy: initiating automatic HOLD on all canary and staggered rollouts. Release tagged as paused. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-789 :warning:

leo: oncall here — confirming pause. Kicking canary rollback on eu-subzone-1 now (rolling back to v3.2.0). ETA ~2m. will tail ingress logs and post update. @maria fyi

sam: thanks. do we want to pin traffic to v3.2.0 in eu until this is fully resolved?

maria: yes, pin traffic to v3.2.0 for eu-prod. also propose we reschedule the v3.2.1 reattempt to tomorrow 02:00 UTC and use a staggered-10m policy across zones. add note to release notes: "paused due to EU ingress 503; reattempt scheduled pending postmortem"

deploy-bot: executing rollback: target=eu-subzone-1, from=v3.2.1 -> to=v3.2.0. Commands run:
```
/deploy rollback --env=prod-eu --tag=v3.2.0 --target=canary
```
Rollback completed on 3 hosts. Monitoring metrics.

ops-oncall: errors dropped after rollback, latency back to baseline on canaries. Recommend reschedule: 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC, staggered 10m per zone, canary size 2->5, smoke ingress checks before promotion.

maria: agreed. I'll update the release doc + release notes and notify stakeholders. deploy-bot, please schedule the reattempt with policy=staggered-10m and set pinned-fallback=v3.2.0. also add a smoke test step for ingress header validation to the pipeline.

deploy-bot: scheduled reschedule: 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z | policy=staggered-10m | pinned-fallback=v3.2.0. Linked INC-789. :white_check_mark:

sam: thanks all — closing this thread for now, monitoring until next window.
